projects.title: Spectral Audio Restoration: Resurrecting 60-Year-Old Monophonic Heritage via Generative AI
projects.summary: Preserving 60-year-old Indian devotional vinyl recordings for a digital-first generation presented a severe archival roadblock: heavily degraded, monophonic tracks fundamentally lack the sonic fidelity required to engage modern streaming audiences. To rescue these legacy cultural artifacts, I engineered an "AI-Remix" workflow, utilizing advanced stem-separation algorithms to surgically extract clean, isolated vocal tracks from the deteriorating archival noise. Once the ancestral vocals were secured, I layered them into a professional audio pipeline alongside high-fidelity, newly composed instrumental arrangements generated via Suno AI. Bridging the gap between the "Vinyl Era" and the "AI Era," this project proved that generative audio technology isn't just for creating novel content—it is an unprecedented tool for cultural preservation capable of capturing entirely new, younger demographics. projects.title: AI-Powered Vocal Isolation: Engineering the First Mass Karaoke Library for Tamil Christian Hymns

By chaining advanced machine learning protocols, algorithmic vocal isolation, and stem separation tools, the system rapidly stripped the dense vocals from 600 legacy source audios, reconstructing professional, broadcast-grade instrumental tracks in a fraction of traditional post-production time. This high-volume automated workflow established the only comprehensive Tamil Christian karaoke library of its kind—creating a wildly popular, monopoly platform that is now exclusively relied upon by churches and global Tamil communities for congregational singing. projects.title: Generative Audio Orchestration: Pioneering a Novel Niche for Tamil Christian Instrumental Music
projects.summary: Within traditional Tamil culture, listening to purely instrumental devotional music is a surprisingly absent niche, constantly leaving congregations with no alternative but to play secular cinematic music as background tracks for church and community functions. To completely shift this cultural reliance and build a library of high-fidelity background worship, I engineered the "Vetrisaithuthi" digital platform. The pipeline utilizes AI stem separation to extract the core melodic structure from legacy Tamil Christian tracks—isolating and removing both the vocals and the dated source audio—and feeds that clean data directly into Suno AI. This allows the generative audio model to completely re-orchestrate the legacy melodies into rich, modern, purely instrumental compositions. By successfully automating studio-level orchestral arrangements, this project pioneers a brand-new cultural listening space, substituting cinema music with immersive gospel arrangements to strengthen community faith. projects.title: Retroactive AI Production: Orchestrating My 15-Year-Old Original Tamil Compositions
projects.summary: Fifteen years ago, bringing my original Tamil lyrical compositions to life was severely bottlenecked by extreme financial and technical barriers, leaving my creative output confined to basic manual keyboard recordings on an early computer. To finally give these deeply personal tracks the grand musical arrangements I had always envisioned but could never afford, I engineered a retroactive AI production workflow. By utilizing advanced audio stem separation, I successfully extracted the raw, original vocal stems from my decades-old legacy files. Feeding my historical performances into Suno AI, the generative model synthesized full-scale, professional background orchestrations that perfectly harmonize with my original voice and lyrics. This ongoing project entirely bypasses traditional studio costs, proving AI's profound ability to resurrect stalled artistic visions as I work through modernizing a personal vault of over 50 unreleased original compositions. projects.title: Cross-Lingual AI Orchestration: Cloning a Tamil Melodic Meter in French
projects.summary: Translating a deeply beloved cultural track—like the classic Tamil Franciscan hymn "அமைதியின் தூதனாய்" (Make Me an Instrument of Peace)—into a foreign language usually destroys the rhythmic meter, making it impossible to sing to the original melody. To execute a seamless cross-cultural musical bridge, I engineered a unique melodic-cloning workflow. First, I isolated the original Tamil vocals using stem separation to serve as my baseline. Next, I utilized targeted prompt engineering within an LLM (AI Studio) to translate the deep theology of the lyrics into French while strictly locking the output to the precise syllable count, poetic structure, and meter of the Tamil track. Armed with these rhythm-matched French lyrics, I deployed Suno AI through extensive targeted iterations, meticulously coercing the generative model to sing the new French text entirely to the exact, nostalgic melody of the Tamil classic. This unprecedented creative attempt proves that generative AI can successfully perform cross-lingual audio adaptation without losing the original musical "soul" of a regional legacy track. projects.title: Zero-Budget Cinematic Generation: End-to-End Fully AI Filmmaking in 3 Hours

Defying traditional workflows, this professional-grade film went from a blank page to a finalized visual render in just three hours of total work—earning high critical acclaim and prompting DBIMA to invite me to teach these exact "creative disruption" techniques to my Master's peers. projects.title: Hybrid Theatrical Production: Engineering "L’Hôte Attendu" Across a French Language Barrier
projects.summary: Executing the live theatrical play "L’Hôte Attendu" (The Awaited Guest) for a French Christmas Vigil presented a formidable directorial roadblock: possessing the creative vision but lacking the French fluency to write the script and dynamically direct live actors in their native language. To bridge this communication gap, I engineered a comprehensive AI-assisted pipeline that front-loaded the entire auditory experience. After mapping my narrative via Gemini to produce a culturally accurate French script, I processed raw mobile voice-overs from a native actor through Adobe Podcast AI to achieve pristine, studio-quality dialogue. By analyzing this dialogue in Google AI Studio, I reverse-engineered the precise acoustic prompts needed to synthesize an atmospheric score via Suno AI, blending the final stems in Audacity. Providing the live cast with this flawlessly pre-produced master audio allowed for seamless rehearsals and a flawless live performance, which I later synced to stage footage for the final video release. This project is a comprehensive case study in stacking generative tools to conquer real-world linguistic barriers in live theater. projects.summary: While utilizing a no-code CMS like Google Sites provides excellent flexibility for managing daily content, it fundamentally limits modern UI/UX design, resulting in a static, heavily templated front page. When the AI initially output overly complex, multi-file web app structures requiring backend configurations, I utilized rigid prompt-engineering to successfully constrain the model—forcing it to generate a singular, centralized HTML/CSS codeblock exclusively optimized for the strict parameters of a Google Sites full-page iframe. This precise technical negotiation allowed me to bypass the platform's rigid visual limitations, deploying a highly professional, custom-coded modern interface while preserving the effortless backend content management of my CMS. projects.title: AI-Coded UI/UX: Architecting the "Eden OS" Interactive HTML Film Simulator
projects.summary: When shooting the complex network sequences for the film Jesus: an Anti-Virus, providing the actors with highly functional, reactive on-screen graphics ("Eden OS") normally dictated either an entire IT department or an expensive post-production VFX screen-replacement process. To execute this with zero budget and zero manual coding background, I utilized Google AI Studio to architect a bespoke, fully playable operating system built entirely in HTML. This required rigorous directorial foresight: I had to mathematically choreograph exactly what the actors would do during the scene, feeding those exact parameters into the LLM to pre-program the HTML triggers so the software reacted as if they were actually hacking a live network. It took 25 highly strict prompt-engineering iterations to refine the syntax, ultimately outputting a flawless interactive environment that completely replaced post-production VFX with live, on-set software props. This project stands as a prime blueprint for using conversational AI to execute advanced software simulations for cinema.

projects.title: Strategic AI Grant Writing: Architecting Data-Driven NGO Funding Proposals
projects.summary: Securing international funding for community social work traditionally demands an entire administrative department to execute demographic research, financial modeling, and sustainability reporting. Serving as the NGO Secretary, I completely bypassed these organizational constraints by engineering an end-to-end AI grant-writing pipeline, ultimately producing three comprehensive funding proposals from scratch. The workflow initiated with Gemini's reasoning models to scan deep demographic research and pinpoint highly specific, actionable funding gaps. I then compiled massive amounts of targeted raw materials and fed them into Google NotebookLM, successfully forcing the AI to synthesize a foundational project framework that automatically mapped out localized budget contributions, carbon emission projections, and long-term sustainability strategies. After deploying Gemini to sequentially draft chapter-by-chapter narratives, rendering concept imagery via Nano Banana, and formatting the final UI in Canva, I closed the pipeline by uploading the final master-files back into the LLM. By having Gemini directly cross-reference the finished proposals against international grant databases, I rapidly matched our local NGO projects with their absolute optimal global funding partners. This serves as a definitive case study in how AI can act as a massive operational multiplier for the non-profit and humanitarian sectors.

projects.title: Enterprise Data Synthesis: Compressing a 3-Month Administrative Report into 24 Hours
projects.summary: As a Provincial Secretary, generating the massive triennial report—a highly scrutinized document covering three years of provincial finance, administration, social work, missions, and spiritual metrics—traditionally consumed three full months of strenuous manual data extraction. To eliminate this severe administrative bottleneck, I engineered a highly structured, dual-instance data synthesis pipeline utilizing Google NotebookLM. First, I uploaded an exhaustive database of unorganized three-year department records, anchoring them strictly against provincial statutes, Canon Law, and Biblical texts. In a parallel notebook, I analyzed older triennial reports to successfully reverse-engineer the official institutional tone and extract a categorized architectural index. By feeding this architectural framework back into the primary resource database, the AI system sequentially read and synthesized thousands of pages of raw data, generating the complete, accurately formatted report chapter by chapter. Compiled in a master document and styled via Canva, this monumental administrative task was successfully completed and dispatched to the General Body in exactly one day. Rather than attempting a slow, manual draft from scratch, I engineered a massive-context workflow within Google AI Studio to act as a fully automated "career architect." By dumping my entire fragmented life dataset into the model's 2-million-token window, I deployed strict prompt hierarchies to sift the professional signal from the personal noise—commanding the AI to dynamically auto-generate rigid, recruiter-friendly LinkedIn case studies mapped directly to optimal search algorithms. This meta-workflow successfully transformed an empty digital canvas into a dense, data-driven LinkedIn profile, serving as the ultimate Master Trainer case study on how to use AI for high-level executive brand engineering directly from the ground up.
